#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

class Solver {
public:
    class IO {
    private:
        static const int BUFSIZE = 1 << 15;
        char buf[BUFSIZE];
        int bufc;
        int bufi;
        ostream& out;

    public:
        IO(ostream& output = cout) : bufc(0), bufi(0), out(output) {
            // Pre-fill buffer
            fillBuf();
        }

        void fillBuf() {
            bufi = 0;
            bufc = cin.rdbuf()->sgetn(buf, BUFSIZE);
            if (bufc == 0) {
                // Try again if EOF
                if (cin.eof()) {
                    bufc = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        bool pumpBuf() {
            if (bufi == bufc) {
                fillBuf();
            }
            return bufc != 0;
        }

        bool isDelimiter(char c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f';
        }

        void eatDelimiters() {
            while (true) {
                if (bufi == bufc) {
                    fillBuf();
                    if (bufc == 0) throw runtime_error("IO: Out of input.");
                }
                if (!isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) break;
                ++bufi;
            }
        }

        string next() {
            try {
                eatDelimiters();
                int start = bufi;
                string result;
                while (true) {
                    if (bufi == bufc) {
                        result.append(buf + start, bufi - start);
                        fillBuf();
                        start = 0;
                        if (bufc == 0) break;
                    }
                    if (isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) break;
                    ++bufi;
                }
                result.append(buf + start, bufi - start);
                return result;
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error("IO.next: Caught IOException.");
            }
        }

        int nextInt() {
            try {
                int ret = 0;
                eatDelimiters();
                bool positive = true;
                if (buf[bufi] == '-') {
                    ++bufi;
                    if (!pumpBuf()) throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
                    positive = false;
                }
                bool first = true;
                while (true) {
                    if (!pumpBuf()) break;
                    if (isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) {
                        if (first) throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
                        break;
                    }
                    first = false;
                    if (buf[bufi] >= '0' && buf[bufi] <= '9') {
                        if (ret < -214748364) throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
                        ret *= 10;
                        ret -= (int)(buf[bufi] - '0');
                        if (ret > 0) throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
                    } else {
                        throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
                    }
                    ++bufi;
                }
                if (positive) {
                    if (ret == -2147483648) throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
                    ret = -ret;
                }
                return ret;
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Caught IOException.");
            }
        }

        long long nextLong() {
            try {
                long long ret = 0;
                eatDelimiters();
                bool positive = true;
                if (buf[bufi] == '-') {
                    ++bufi;
                    if (!pumpBuf()) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                    positive = false;
                }
                bool first = true;
                while (true) {
                    if (!pumpBuf()) break;
                    if (isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) {
                        if (first) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                        break;
                    }
                    first = false;
                    if (buf[bufi] >= '0' && buf[bufi] <= '9') {
                        if (ret < -922337203685477580LL) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                        ret *= 10;
                        ret -= (long long)(buf[bufi] - '0');
                        if (ret > 0) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                    } else {
                        throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                    }
                    ++bufi;
                }
                if (positive) {
                    if (ret == -9223372036854775808LL) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                    ret = -ret;
                }
                return ret;
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Caught IOException.");
            }
        }

        void println(long long x) {
            out << x << '\n';
            out.flush();
        }

        void println(int x) {
            out << x << '\n';
            out.flush();
        }

        void println(string s) {
            out << s << '\n';
            out.flush();
        }

        void close() {
            out.flush();
        }
    };

    IO io;

    Solver() : io() {
        try {
            solve();
        } catch (runtime_error& e) {
            if (string(e.what()) != "Clean exit") {
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    void solve() {
        long long n = io.nextLong();
        long long m = io.nextLong();
        if (m < n) {
            long long temp = m;
            m = n;
            n = temp;
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            io.println(brute1(m));
            return;
        }
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m < 3) io.println(0);
            else if (m == 3) io.println(4);
            else if (m == 7) io.println(12);
            else io.println(2 * m);
            return;
        }

        long long total = n * m;
        long long result = total - (total & 1);
        io.println(result);
    }

    long long brute1(long long m) {
        long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
        long long remainder = m % 6;
        if (remainder == 5) ans += 4;
        else if (remainder == 4) ans += 2;
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    new Solver();
    return 0;
}
